name: CV Builder
tagline: Build a clean, ATS friendly CV and download the PDF. No account, no paywall on the download button.

name: Subscription Finder
tagline: Find likely recurring charges in a bank CSV. No account, no bank connection, no uploads.

name: Google Storage Analyser
tagline: See what is actually eating your Google storage before you pay for more. Read only, nothing uploaded.

name: Screen Recorder
tagline: Record your screen, voice and a camera bubble with no time cap. Saves straight to your computer.

name: Background Remover
tagline: Remove a photo background on your device. Download an original-size PNG, free and without a watermark.

name: Sign a PDF
tagline: Sign and fill a PDF without creating an account.

name: QR Codes
tagline: Static QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi and email. Free PNG and SVG downloads, with no expiry or scan limit.

name: Invoice Generator
tagline: Australian invoices and quotes with GST and ABN, as a PDF.

name: GPX Route Builder & Heatmap
tagline: Explore your GPX activities, build a personal heatmap and draw routes to download. Files stay on your device.

name: Image Converter
tagline: HEIC to JPG, batch resize and location data removed, all in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Is It Worth It? Calculators
tagline: Nine break even calculators: seat selection, checked bags, cruise wifi, theme park parking, Vinted bumps, Etsy ads, eBay labels, Uber One and airport fast track.

name: Browser Transcription
tagline: Turn English audio into editable text and SRT subtitles on your device. No audio uploads or account.

name: Read aloud
tagline: Listen to text and PDFs with your device’s local voices. Follow each sentence and resume where you stopped.

name: Measurement Notebook
tagline: Label dimensions on a photo and download an annotated image or PDF. No account or uploads.

name: Settle Up
tagline: Split group expenses and get the fewest transfers that square everyone up. The ledger lives in the share link; no account.

name: Tuner and Metronome
tagline: Chromatic tuner with instrument presets and a metronome on the audio clock. No ads, no subscription, and it works offline.

name: Habit Tracker
tagline: Track as many habits as you like, with streaks that understand rest days and a year of history. Works offline, no account.
